units.axes: model space: +Y down, -Z is the front of the entity, -X is its right side
units.rotation: radians; a part applies Z, then Y, then X to its parent frame (a vertex is turned about X first)
units.size: blocks; width, height and eye_height of the standing adult; a baby scales them by its age scale
units.update_interval: ticks between two position updates of the server
units.data: entity data entries in index order; wire_type is the type id of the entity data codec
